_about: Deliberate exceptions to test/occasionsExposure.test.js: an occasions setting or occasion field the server accepts but the admin has no control for yet. Every entry needs a reason and EITHER an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD; the test fails after it so the exception gets revisited) OR permanent:true. Add a control instead whenever you can.
